https://github.com/0ad/0ad/tree/61a3b9507d974084e6badb88a0826bd89a6d5b8b/binaries/data/mods/public/art/meshes/props/helmet

Luanshi contributors refitted han_cap, han_cavalry_swordsman_helmet,
han_officer_helmet_01 and han_heavy_helmet_b to the company's head bind,
shortened the heavy helmet's top brush, fitted the rolled brow edges, removed
coincident inward faces, and reassigned matte colour fields.
The four derived meshes remain separate from the underlying faces, uniforms and
weapons. No upstream texture is redistributed. The original editable vertices,
per-file Git blob hashes and repeatable fit are in tools/art/fit_field_headwear.py.
The Han-era source art serves as a visual starting point for fictional field issues.
This adaptation does not imply endorsement by Wildfire Games.
